framework_lessons: Debt composition matters more than gross totals.
assessment: SPG reached its numerical price target and showed operating resilience. The tactical long-bond preference failed at six and twelve months. Manufacturing contraction, travel recovery and yield-curve inversion worked; broad recession and debt vulnerability narratives need finer distinctions. Successful dividend increases must remain separate from relative equity returns. Product plans, market-cap ratios and risk-adjusted superlatives retain explicit evidentiary limits.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
